title: Explicit Crop-Root State Snapshot and Root-Uptake Input Assembly Seam
purpose: Resolve the F-WOF12 data-ownership blocker structurally by separating current crop-root state/view data from current ET potential-transpiration data and assembling the already-qualified F-WOF11 root-uptake DTO explicitly.

ownership.potential_transpiration_semantics: ET physics result for the current evaluation interval/timestep

crop_root_state_view_t.note: rooted_nodes and cumulative_root_fraction may be derived by a future crop host from more compact committed root state; this seam does not require them to be persisted

assembly_contract.active_nodes_argument: explicit immutable/grid context required only for contract validation
assembly_contract.inactive_crop: requires canonical inactive snapshot, ignores ET value, emits canonical zero/unallocated F-WOF11 DTO
assembly_contract.active_zero_root: requires finite nonnegative ptra and no distribution allocation
assembly_contract.active_rooted: requires current valid cumulative distribution and finite nonnegative ptra

time_and_ordering.future_host_requirement: the crop-root view and ET result supplied to this assembler must be current at the intended root-uptake evaluation point
time_and_ordering.B110_reference_constraint: for the admitted reference route, current-day root extension/distribution must not be advanced before current-day root extraction

required_gates: only one new production crop source
new module has no runtime, solver, HeadCalc, legacy-global, file-I/O or calendar dependency
canonical inactive view plus invalid/stale ET still produces canonical inactive DTO without reading ET
active invalid root distribution fails closed
assembled DTO through F-MR12 is bitwise identical to direct F-MR10 path
snapshot and ET input are read-only
A/B/A deterministic assembly and downstream evaluation

qualification_boundary.this_can_qualify: pure data-category separation and assembly seam
